accepted_principles: no Docker socket inside the inner capture container

blocking_gaps.gap: The design mounts the exact source read-only and declares only /tmp, /run and /out writable. The supplemental capture must perform a qualification build, so Gradle/Kotlin need a writable build workspace. Writing into /src is prohibited and the design does not define a verified source-derived workspace.
blocking_gaps.required_fix: Add an ephemeral writable /work filesystem. Copy the exact read-only source input into /work/source, verify the copy against a canonical source inventory before execution, build only there, and verify the immutable /src input remains unchanged.

blocking_gaps.gap: Network is correctly disabled, but the design does not mount the accepted design's required immutable verified Gradle/compiler/plugin/runtime dependency store. A fresh Gradle build cannot rely on undeclared host caches or network fallback.
blocking_gaps.required_fix: Predeclare a separately captured and independently accepted dependency/tool input store by canonical manifest digest, mount it read-only at /inputs, populate any writable Gradle cache only from those verified bytes, and force offline/no-fallback resolution.

blocking_gaps.gap: The proposed /tmp tmpfs is noexec. JVM/Gradle/Kotlin/native tooling can legitimately materialize native helper libraries or launch artifacts in temporary/build storage. A noexec failure would be infrastructure ambiguity rather than a meaningful capture result.
blocking_gaps.required_fix: Keep /tmp and /work nosuid,nodev but permit execution where the pinned toolchain requires it; rely on exact image/tool hashes, read-only inputs, network-none, capability dropping and process/source lifetime validation rather than a blanket noexec assumption.

blocking_gaps.gap: The design checks launch mounts but does not yet require the actual capture to prove every resolved build/runtime artifact came from the accepted read-only store.
blocking_gaps.required_fix: Actual capture must emit the ordered resolved dependency graph and map every artifact byte to the accepted store manifest; any external, missing, dynamically changed or unverified artifact fails before runtime capture.

non_authority: No runtime capture, expected manifest, prepared worker, R1 permit, claim, seed, allocation or game authority.
next_gate: Revise the sealed launch design with immutable /src and /inputs plus ephemeral verified /work, explicit offline resolution, and complete dependency-store provenance; independently review the revised design before launch qualification.
